# 智算架构志 / LLM Systems Architecture

> 本站是大模型推理架构与系统工程笔记，覆盖 vLLM 服务、DeepSeek MLA、InfiniBand 网络与生产级 Agent 运行时。
> Notes for engineers on LLM inference architecture and systems engineering: vLLM serving, MLA attention, InfiniBand fabrics, and production Agent runtimes.

- Site URL: https://blog.llmgo.top
- Author: ifnodoraemon (LLM Systems Architect)
- GitHub: https://github.com/ifnodoraemon
- Full Knowledge Base: https://blog.llmgo.top/llms-full.txt
- Core Focus: LLM inference architecture (vLLM, MLA, PagedAttention), InfiniBand and kernel networking, and production Agent runtimes.

## 核心专栏体系 / Topic Series & Clusters

### 中文专栏 (Chinese Series)
- [《AI Agent 生产级架构师手册》](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/agent-loop-state-machine/): 系统化掌握 2026 生产级 AI Agent 核心架构：从执行循环、状态机控制流，到 MCP 协议、Skills 扩展、多智能体协作与全链路可观测性。 (14 篇文章，开篇：[agent-loop-state-machine](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/agent-loop-state-machine/))
- [《大模型推理引擎：从模型演进、内核架构到未来终局》](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/inference-roofline-prefill-decode/): 以第一性原理贯穿大模型推理系统：从 Prefill/Decode 物理撕裂与 Roofline 模型推导、KV Cache 与 MLA 显存突围，到 PagedAttention、Continuous Batching、P/D 解耦、四大引擎 (vLLM / SGLang / TRT-LLM / llama.cpp) 源码解密与长思考链调度终局。 (10 篇文章，开篇：[inference-roofline-prefill-decode](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/inference-roofline-prefill-decode/))
- [《从 Docker 到 Kubernetes：云原生容器与集群编排架构指南》](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs/): 系统化掌握云原生容器与集群编排体系：从 Linux 内核进程隔离、veth 网络、SwarmKit 共识到 K8s 控制面原理；深入业务软件在 K8s 上的网络（gRPC/Mesh/优雅停机）与存储（Local NVMe/RocksDB/Fencing）工程实战；并进阶对 K8s 本身“动刀”：Scheduling Framework 自定义调度器、NRI/Kata 运行时改造、Aggregated APIServer 与 2026 AI GPU 智算终局。 (13 篇文章，开篇：[docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs/))
- [《深入浅出计算机网络：从以太网原理到万卡 InfiniBand 架构实战》](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp/): 零基础直通万卡 AI 智算网络：从电信号高低电平、双绞线与光纤、集线器冲突域到交换机广播域与 MAC/ARP 寻址；手把手深入推导 IP 寻址、二进制按位与子网掩码（Subnet Mask）计算、默认网关与 VLAN/DHCP/NAT 企业级基建；解析 DNS、Socket 套接字五元组、TCP 11 状态机与 BBR 拥塞控制；攻坚 Linux 内核 NAPI、sk_buff 与 eBPF XDP 极速转发；穿透现代数据中心传统三层 vs 两层 Spine-Leaf 架构与 EVPN-VXLAN；并最终登顶智算中心通信之巅：RoCEv2 无损以太网、纯血 InfiniBand NDR/XDR 物理速率与信元流控、Rail-Optimized 胖树拓扑、自适应路由、SHARP 网内计算与生产级 OFED/NCCL 极限调优。 (12 篇文章，开篇：[network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp/))
- [《现代大模型实战工程与技术选型手册》](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/): 系统剖析前沿大模型落地方法论：企业级 RAG、模型全流程微调、Test-Time Compute 扩展与 GRPO 强化学习、拒绝榜单刷分的 Eval 体系以及主流模型横评。

### 英文专栏 (English Series)
- [The Production AI Agent Architect Handbook](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/agent-loop-state-machine/): Master production-grade AI Agent architectures in 2026: from execution loops and state machines to MCP, skills, multi-agent orchestration, and observability. (14 articles, opening chapter: [agent-loop-state-machine](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/agent-loop-state-machine/))
- [Production LLM Inference Engines: Evolution, Architecture, and Future](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/inference-roofline-prefill-decode/): Master LLM inference systems from first principles: Roofline modeling of Prefill/Decode, KV Cache & MLA memory optimization, PagedAttention, Continuous Batching, P/D disaggregation, and in-depth engine architectures across vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and llama.cpp. (10 articles, opening chapter: [inference-roofline-prefill-decode](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/inference-roofline-prefill-decode/))
- [From Docker to Kubernetes: Cloud-Native Container & Cluster Orchestration Handbook](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs/): Master containerization and cluster orchestration from first principles: Linux namespaces, cgroups v2, SwarmKit, K8s control plane; real-world software architecture on K8s (gRPC/zero-downtime, Local NVMe/RocksDB/fencing); hacking K8s internals (Scheduling Framework plugins, NRI runtimes, Aggregated APIServer); and 2026 AI GPU scheduling. (13 articles, opening chapter: [docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs/))
- [Computer Networking Masterclass: From Ethernet Principles to Hyperscale InfiniBand Architecture](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp/): A ground-zero masterclass to 10,000-GPU AI networking: from physical voltages, twisted pairs, and optical fibers to hubs, collision domains, switches, and MAC/ARP; step-by-step binary derivations of IP addressing, subnet masks, default gateways, VLANs, DHCP, and NAT; in-depth DNS, Socket 5-tuples, TCP 11-state machines, and BBR congestion control; Linux kernel NAPI, sk_buff, and eBPF XDP; datacenter traditional 3-tier vs 2-tier Spine-Leaf fabrics and EVPN-VXLAN; leading up to AI supercomputing: lossless RoCEv2, native InfiniBand NDR/XDR link speeds, credit flow control, Rail-Optimized Fat-Trees, Adaptive Routing, SHARP, and bare-metal OFED/NCCL performance tuning. (12 articles, opening chapter: [network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp/))
- [Modern Applied LLM Engineering & Selection Guide](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/): Enterprise RAG pipelines, fine-tuning workflows, Test-Time Compute & GRPO, evaluation suites, and multi-model benchmark selections.

## 中文文章索引 / Chinese Technical Articles (71 篇)

- [DeepSeek 生产推理栈：DeepInfer 与 deepseek-recipe](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/deepinfer-deepseek-recipe-architecture/): 介绍 DeepSeek 生产推理栈：DeepInfer 的算子与 PD 分离、DSpark 投机解码，以及 deepseek-recipe 如何对接上层协议。
- [InfiniBand 生产调优：OpenSM 与 NCCL](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/infiniband-production-deployment-opensm-ofed-nccl-tuning/): InfiniBand 生产部署要点：OFED 驱动、OpenSM 主备、ibdiagnet 巡检，以及 NCCL 的 GPUDirect RDMA 调优。
- [InfiniBand 组网：胖树、Rail 优化与 SHARP](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/infiniband-fat-tree-rail-optimized-topology-adaptive-routing-sharp/): 说明万卡 GPU 集群如何用 Fat-Tree 与 Rail-Optimized 布线，以及自适应路由和 SHARP 网内计算如何改善集合通信。
- [InfiniBand 架构：速率、信用流控与子网管理](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/infiniband-architecture-hardware-rates-credit-flow-subnet-manager/): 讲解 InfiniBand 从 HDR、NDR 到 XDR 的链路速率，基于信用的链路流控如何避免丢包，以及 OpenSM 如何下发转发表。
- [Linux 内核网络：NAPI、Ring Buffer 与 XDP](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/linux-kernel-networking-napi-ring-buffer-skbuff-xdp/): 讲解网卡接收环、DMA 与 NAPI 轮询如何收包，sk_buff 如何在内核中流转，以及 eBPF XDP 在驱动层如何丢弃或转发，也讲 RSS。
- [RDMA 基础：内核旁路、Queue Pair 与 RoCEv2](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/rdma-kernel-bypass-zero-copy-queue-pair-rocev2-lossless/): 讲解 RDMA 如何注册内存、旁路内核并零拷贝，Queue Pair 如何收发，以及 RoCEv2 怎样用 PFC 和 ECN 减少丢包，含原子操作。
- [数据中心网络：Clos、Leaf-Spine 与 EVPN](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/datacenter-network-clos-leaf-spine-bgp-evpn-vxlan/): 说明数据中心为何用 Clos 与 Leaf-Spine 替代传统三层加 STP，以及 BGP Underlay 和 EVPN-VXLAN 如何延伸二层。
- [DNS、Socket 与 TCP/UDP 对比](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/transport-bridge-dns-sockets-ports-udp-vs-tcp/): 说明 DNS 如何从根递归解析到权威服务器，Socket 五元组如何让一个端口承载多条连接，以及 UDP 与 TCP 的取舍，含 Anycast 根。
- [企业局域网：VLAN、DHCP 与 NAT](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/enterprise-lan-vlan-8021q-dhcp-nat-port-forwarding/): 说明 802.1Q VLAN 如何把一台交换机划成多个广播域，DHCP 如何用 DORA 分配地址，以及 NAPT 如何做端口映射，含 Access 口。
- [TCP 拥塞控制：Reno、Cubic、BBR 与 QUIC](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/tcp-congestion-control-reno-cubic-bbr-quic-http3/): 比较丢包驱动的 Reno、Cubic 和按带宽时延建模的 BBR，并说明 HTTP/3 如何改用 QUIC 承载原来的 TCP 流量，谈缓冲膨胀。
- [IP 寻址：子网掩码、CIDR 与默认网关](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/ip-addressing-subnet-mask-cidr-default-gateway-routing/): 用二进制说明子网掩码和 CIDR 如何划分 IPv4 的网络号与主机号，以及数据包离开本网段时默认网关承担什么角色，并算出网络地址与可用主机范围。
- [IP 路由与 TCP 状态机、滑动窗口](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/network-layer-transport-layer-ip-routing-tcp-state-machine/): 讲解 IP 如何用最长前缀匹配选路，TCP 十一种状态如何完成握手与挥手，以及滑动窗口怎样限制在途数据，并解释 SYN Cookie 与 TIME_WAIT。
- [计算机网络入门：介质、冲突域与 MAC](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/network-fundamentals-bits-cables-hubs-switches-mac-arp/): 从比特、双绞线和光纤讲起，说明集线器冲突域、交换机如何学习 MAC，以及 ARP 怎样把 IP 解析成网卡硬件地址。文中也讲到 CSMA/CD。
- [容器网络：veth、Linux Bridge 与 iptables](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/container-networking-veth-bridge-iptables/): 说明容器报文如何经 veth-pair 离开网络命名空间，在 Linux Bridge 上按 MAC 交换，再由 iptables NAT 访问外网。
- [Docker 内核：Namespace、cgroups 与 OverlayFS](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/docker-internals-namespace-cgroups-overlayfs/): 说明容器不是轻量虚拟机，而是受限的 Linux 进程：Namespace 隔离视野，cgroups v2 限制资源，OverlayFS 存放分层镜像。
- [Docker Swarm：Raft 共识与 Routing Mesh](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/docker-swarm-architecture-raft-routing-mesh/): 说明 SwarmKit 的 Manager 与 Worker 如何分工，Raft 如何保持集群状态一致，以及 IPVS Routing Mesh 如何发布服务。
- [K8s 应用网络：gRPC 均衡与平滑切流](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-application-networking-grpc-service-mesh-zero-downtime/): 说明 gRPC 长连接为何让 Kubernetes Service 负载倾斜，以及 Service Mesh 如何按连接排空，做到发布时不断流量。
- [K8s 控制平面：声明式 API 与调谐循环](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-control-plane-declarative-reconciliation/): 讲解 Kubernetes 如何用声明式 API 保存期望状态，etcd 如何存储它，调度器如何选节点，控制器如何用调谐循环收敛，含 Informer。
- [K8s 控制面：聚合 APIServer、APF 与 etcd](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-control-plane-hacking-aggregated-apiserver-apf-etcd/): 说明 WatchCache、聚合 APIServer 和 APF 如何扩展 Kubernetes 控制面，以及节点规模变大以后 etcd 需要做哪些调优。
- [K8s 上的数据库：Local NVMe 与 Fencing](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-database-storage-local-nvme-tuning-fencing/): 说明在 Kubernetes 上用本地 NVMe 跑数据库时，如何调整 RocksDB 与 WAL 刷盘，并用 Fencing 避免旧主继续写入。
- [K8s GPU 调度：GPU Operator、MIG 与推理扩缩](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-gpu-operator-ai-inference-scheduling/): 说明 GPU Operator 如何安装驱动与设备插件，MIG 如何切分 GPU，以及拓扑感知调度怎样扩缩 vLLM 和 SGLang，面向在线推理。
- [K8s 网络：CNI、Cilium eBPF 与 Gateway API](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-networking-cni-cilium-ebpf-gateway-api/): 比较 Flannel、Calico BGP 与 Cilium eBPF 的数据面差异，并说明 Gateway API 如何把流量策略拆给不同角色来管理。
- [K8s Operator：CRD 与 KubeBuilder](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-operator-pattern-kubebuilder-crd/): 说明 Operator 如何把人工运维写成控制器，CRD 如何注册新资源，以及 KubeBuilder 的调谐循环和 Finalizer 如何清理实例。
- [K8s 运行时：NRI、Kata、gVisor 与 cgroups](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-runtime-nri-kata-gvisor-kernel-tuning/): 讲解节点上 PLEG 为何会拖慢同步，NRI 插件如何改容器配置，以及 Kata、gVisor 和 cgroups v2 各自限制什么，以免拖死。
- [K8s 调度扩展：Framework 插件与 Gang](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-scheduling-framework-custom-plugin-gang-scheduling/): 说明 Scheduling Framework 的扩展点如何接入自定义插件，以及 Gang Scheduling 与 Descheduler 处理 Pod。
- [K8s 存储：CSI、PV/PVC 与 StatefulSet](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/k8s-storage-csi-statefulset-deep-dive/): 说明 CSI 如何按需创建 PV 和 PVC，以及 StatefulSet 怎样为每个 Pod 保持稳定的网络标识和对应的存储卷，重启后仍在。
- [连续批处理：Chunked Prefill 与排头阻塞](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/continuous-batching-chunked-prefill-guide/): 说明连续批处理之后，一次超长 Prefill 为何仍会挡住其他请求的 Decode，以及 Chunked Prefill 如何把这段计算拆开穿插执行。
- [Attention 算子：FlashAttention 与 FlashInfer](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/flashattention-flashinfer-kernel-evolution/): 回顾 FlashAttention 如何在 SRAM 中分块计算注意力，以及 FlashInfer 如何用同一条内核路径读取分页 KV 并完成 Decode。
- [推理引擎对比：vLLM、SGLang、TRT-LLM、llama.cpp](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/inference-engines-core-architecture-internals/): 对比 vLLM v1、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 与 llama.cpp 的调度循环和执行后端，方便按吞吐、延迟和硬件条件选择推理引擎。
- [Roofline 模型：Prefill 与 Decode 的差异](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/inference-roofline-prefill-decode/): 用 Roofline 模型说明 Prefill 更吃算力、Decode 更吃显存带宽，以及这种差别如何分开 TTFT 和 TPOT 两个延迟。
- [MHA、GQA 与 MLA：注意力和推理显存](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/mha-gqa-mla-matrix-absorption-inference-engine/): 比较 MHA、GQA 与 DeepSeek MLA 的 KV Cache 占用，并说明 Decode 时矩阵吸收如何少存多头张量、降低显存带宽压力。
- [稀疏大模型 MoE 推理内核：专家并行 (EP)、动态路由门控与 All-to-All 通信重叠](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/moe-expert-parallelism-inference-engine/): 为什么 671B 参数的 DeepSeek-V3 每次解码仅激活 37B 参数，吞吐却常受制于跨节点网络？深度剖析稀疏大模型 MoE 推理内核：从动态门控与无辅助损失负载均衡，到专家并行 (EP) All-to-Allv 通信瓶颈，再到 CUTLASS Grouped GEMM 算子融合与 DualPipe 通信计算重叠终极优化。
- [PagedAttention：分页 KV Cache 与显存碎片](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/pagedattention-memory-virtualization/): 说明 PagedAttention 如何把 KV Cache 分成逻辑块再映射到物理显存，从而减少碎片，并让多个序列以写时复制共享前缀，用于在线服务。
- [P/D 分离：Prefill 与 Decode 解耦及 KV 传输](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/pd-disaggregation-distributed-kv-cache/): 说明 Prefill 与 Decode 为什么要分池部署，KV Cache 如何经 RDMA 在节点间传递，以及集群怎样把这些缓存池化调度。
- [前缀缓存：Hash 块寻址与 RadixAttention](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/prefix-caching-radix-attention-internals/): 说明前缀缓存如何用块哈希复用已算过的 KV，以及 SGLang RadixAttention 如何在基数树上匹配前缀并用 LRU 驱逐叶子。
- [长思维链推理：Test-Time Compute 与 KV 调度](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/reasoning-test-time-compute-inference-future/): 说明变长思维链如何放大 KV Cache 占用，以及测试时计算、投机树调度和分层 KV 存储要在推理系统里解决什么问题。调度策略也要跟着改。
- [AI Agent 记忆系统设计：从工作记忆、情景记忆到分层 Graph RAG](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/agent-memory-architecture/): 解析 Agent 工作、情景与长期记忆，结合 MemGPT 和 Generative Agents 解释检索与衰减，并补充来源追踪、权限过滤、冲突处理和删除传播的生产边界。
- [Agent 执行循环与状态机设计：从 ReAct 到确定性控制流](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/agent-loop-state-machine/): 为什么单纯的 Prompt 链与自由 ReAct 无法支撑生产级系统？深度拆解 Agent 执行循环的四大失效模式、基于有限状态机 (FSM) 的图控流设计、Tool Calling 容错降级与熔断器机制，并提供生产级状态机实战代码。
- [Browser-use 架构：DOM 提纯与视觉定位](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/browser-use-agent-architecture/): 说明 Browser-use 如何精简 DOM、用视觉标记定位可点击元素，并把页面操作放进带状态和重试的 Agent 循环，用于网页自动化。
- [SGLang 与 vLLM 架构对比：前缀缓存、结构化输出与评测方法](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/sglang-vs-vllm-architecture/): 比较 SGLang RadixAttention 与 vLLM APC 的前缀复用机制、结构化输出和部署基线，并给出控制变量、冷暖缓存及延迟吞吐的可复现评测方法。
- [投机解码：从 Draft Model 到 EAGLE-3](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/speculative-decoding-eagle-guide/): 说明投机解码为何可以不改变采样分布，以及从草稿模型、Medusa 到 EAGLE-3，在 vLLM 和 SGLang 里怎样打开这项加速，可对照配置。
- [GRPO 与 Test-Time Compute：从 PPO 到无 Critic](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/test-time-compute-grpo/): 说明测试时计算把算力挪到生成阶段之后，GRPO 如何去掉 PPO 的 Critic，改为用同一组采样的相对优势更新策略。文中给出可复现的实现要点。
- [DeepSeek-V4 与 Kimi K3 部署：32 卡拓扑与排障](https://blog.llmgo.top/articles/deepseek-v4-kimi-k3-deployment-guide/): 部署 DeepSeek-V4 与 Kimi K3：四机 32 卡拓扑，并排查 NUMA、MoE 路由、CUDA Graph 伪 OOM 与 PFC 死锁。

- [Agent Orchestration and Evals for Compounding Error](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/agent-orchestration-evals/): How a small per-step error compounds across an agent workflow, and how splitting work with orchestration plus repeatable evals keeps that drift visible.
- [Deep Dive into AI Agent Architecture Evolution: From Prompt to Loop Engineering](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/loop-engineering/): A deep dive into the evolution of AI Agent architectures, exploring the 4-layer control plane extrapolation from Prompt, Context, Harness to Loop Engineering, and the 4 diseases of the ReAct architecture.
- [Advanced Tool Use in Agent Architecture: Dynamic Discovery, Sandboxing, and Self-Healing Recovery](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/advanced-agent-tool-use-and-function-calling/): Implement dynamic tool retrieval, MCP initialization and pagination, gVisor container execution, cleanup after timeouts, and bounded recovery with Python examples.
- [Building a Lightweight Agent Framework from Scratch: State Machines and Event Streams](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/build-lightweight-agent-framework/): Build a Python agent state machine with SQLite approval checkpoints, restart recovery, single-use approvals, rejection handling, step budgets, and async events.
- [Communication Protocols and Concurrency Control in Multi-Agent Systems](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/multi-agent-collaboration-and-concurrency/): Build asyncio agent mailboxes and a message bus with isolated payload copies, bounded delivery, graceful shutdown, CAS document updates, and token-bucket limiting.
- [Agent Observability & Debugging: The Path from Black Box to White Box](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/agent-observability-debugging/): AI Agents are not traditional software; we are debugging the reasoning process rather than the code itself. This article explores Trajectory Evaluation, LLM-as-a-Judge, and practical applications of mainstream Agent observability tools like LangSmith and Langfuse.
- [Context Engineering Guide: Managing Context Window like RAM](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/context-engineering-guide/): The hottest concept in 2026, evolving from Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering. A deep dive into managing the context window through Write, Select, Compress, and Isolate strategies to solve long-context amnesia, hallucinations, and context poisoning.
- [AI Coding Mastery: From 'Build Me an X' to Architecture Orchestrator](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/ai-coding-mastery/): Tools don't matter — methodology does. A deep dive into six core methods for mastering AI coding: Spec-Driven Development, Context Engineering, TDD Verification Loops, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Advanced Prompting, and Session Hygiene. Plus a 20+ tool matrix and five anti-patterns to avoid.
- [Reject Benchmark Hacking: How to Build an LLM Evaluation System for Your Business (LLM-as-a-Judge)](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/llm-evaluation-guide/): Cease the obsession with writing more code; shift focus to deep evaluation thinking. We deconstruct LLM-as-a-Judge biases, the mathematics behind metrics, and reshaping CI/CD defenses for probabilistic systems.
- [LLM Quantization Hands-On Guide: Four Routes from Zero to Production](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/quantization-hands-on-guide/): Hands-on LLM quantization guide: download and run GGUF models (Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, llama.cpp, Ollama), quantize with AWQ/GPTQ, and deploy vLLM FP8 in production with copy-paste code.
- [The Critical Crossroads in AI History: Why Was *That One* Chosen Every Time?](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/ai-history-choices/): A retrospective of six pivotal technology crossroads in AI's seventy-year history, dissecting the compute constraints, data dividends, and scalability logic behind each historical choice.
- [vLLM Online Inference: Architecture, Tuning, and Billing](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/vllm-serving-guide/): How to serve online with vLLM: PagedAttention, continuous batching, prefix caching, an OpenAI-compatible API, tuning, token billing, and Docker monitoring.
- [NVIDIA GPU Driver Stack: Kernel Modules to Containers](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/nvidia-gpu-package-architecture/): How the Linux NVIDIA stack fits together, from nvidia-dkms and userspace libraries to nvidia-utils and the metapackage, on desktops, containers, and DGX hosts.
- [LLM Quantization: FP32 to FP8, INT4, and NF4](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/quantization-precision-guide/): How FP8, INT8, INT4, and NF4 apply to weights, activations, or the KV cache, and which measurements separate memory use, speed, and output quality in practice.
- [7 Runtime Practices for Building AI Agents](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/agent-runtime-practices/): Based on a real data analysis agent project, this article distills 7 reusable Agent Runtime practices covering state exposure, tool design, context control, guardrails, delegation, and trace-driven iteration.
- [MCP Deep Dive: The USB-C Port for AI](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/mcp-guide/): From architecture to hands-on development, a complete guide to the Model Context Protocol. Includes Python SDK tutorial, security mechanisms, and ecosystem comparison.
- [Skills Deep Dive: Give Your AI Coding Assistant a Professional Brain](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/skills-guide/): From core principles to cross-platform practice, a complete guide to the AI coding assistant Skills system. Covers SKILL.md mechanics, six-platform comparison, hands-on writing guide, and best practices.
- [Prompt Engineering Practice Guide](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/prompt-engineering-guide/): An in-depth exploration of designing effective prompts to improve model output quality. Covers core techniques like Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct with practical examples.
- [Deep Dive into 11 AI Foundation Model Trends in 2026](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/ai-trends-2026/): From Thinking reasoning modes to Agentic applications, a deep dive into the top 11 trends in AI foundation models for 2026.
- [Building AI Agent Applications from Scratch](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/build-ai-agent/): A step-by-step guide to building intelligent agent systems using LangChain and the Claude API. Includes complete code and architecture design.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in Practice: Strategies & Production Best Practices](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/rag-in-practice/): A complete guide on how to use retrieval-augmented generation strategies and production best practices. Covers vector databases, semantic chunking, ColBERT reranking, GraphRAG, and automated Ragas evaluation.
- [2026 Model Comparison: GPT-5.4, Claude 4.6, Gemini](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/model-comparison-2026/): Compare GPT-5.4, Claude 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro by API capability, token price, and calling pattern, with checks you can rerun and a self-hosted cost formula.

- [LLM Fine-Tuning Guide: How It Works, Real-World Use Cases, and Workflows](https://blog.llmgo.top/en/articles/fine-tuning-guide/): Discover how LLM fine-tuning works under the hood, explore proven enterprise use cases (LoRA, QLoRA, Full Fine-Tuning), and learn end-to-end workflows from data preparation to vLLM serving.
